description: Status, progress and, once completed, the result of long-running calls (media.import, media.analyze, create.*, export.video, qa.check). Same record as tasks/get. status_message says what it is doing, or where it stands in the queue; for names the media or timeline. wait_seconds (up to 50) answers as soon as any job asked for changes, so one call waits instead of many polls. seconds_left and starts_in_seconds come only when progress so far allows. job_ids reads many and answers {jobs, not_found}, each result in brief (result_summary: lists cut to their first items, with what was cut) unless result is full; result summary does the same for one job. A job whose progress stops for minutes ends with a stalled error, freeing its slot.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long (at most 50 s) for any job asked for to change status, progress or status message; 0 answers at once
